The upper half features a quiz question about anime characters with multiple-choice text and an illustration of Toge Inumaki. In the lower half, the man responds with a wide smile and energetic facial expressions. (3) The scene transitions to another question about character Nanami Kento. The man looks thoughtful before answering confidently. Large white subtitles emphasize his spoken words. He wears a small lapel microphone. (4) The man performs a specific hand gesture, mimicking Gojo Satoru's 'Domain Expansion.' An inset image of the anime character is shown for comparison. The editing is fast-paced, using quick cuts between the man and reference images. (5) Promotional graphics for the 'Jujutsu Kaisen Exhibition' fill the screen, showing posters with Yuta Okkotsu and Geto Suguru. The man appears in small insets, pointing towards the text and pricing information. (6) The man stands in a studio, presenting a discount code 'shasha77' which appears as large yellow text on screen. He concludes with a thumbs-up gesture. The lighting remains bright and even throughout.
